ontology_classes.PRIMITIVE: Irreducible structural building block in the relational foundation (P1 through P12).
ontology_classes.DERIVED: Constructed mathematical relation or object proven from primitives with zero symbolic residual.
ontology_classes.REPRESENTATIONAL_CHOICE: Gauge freedom or coordinate convention (e.g. choice of basis, reference axis).
ontology_classes.CALIBRATION: Physical scale fixing (e.g. Planck constant hbar, speed of light c, state normalization sum = 1).
ontology_classes.EMPIRICAL_PHYSICAL_INPUT: Irreducible physical fact observed from nature that geometry does not derive (e.g. state space dimension d=2 for spin-1/2, physical symmetry group of fundamental interactions).

confidence_levels.ESTABLISHED_WITHIN_QUALIFIED_SCOPE: Formally proved symbolically with zero residual and certified by rigorous boundary audits across tested finite dimensions.
confidence_levels.DERIVED_CONDITIONALLY: Proven subject to explicit mathematical hypotheses (e.g. existence of symmetric informationally complete frames, Zauner's conjecture).
confidence_levels.EMPIRICALLY_SUPPORTED: Reconstructed from numerical evidence or verified on dense discrete grids with residual < 1e-12, but without general analytic termination proof.
confidence_levels.OPEN: Conjecture or unresolved boundary regime where empirical or symbolic evidence is currently incomplete.
